title: 湛碧轩 Zhanbi Xuan
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 4.84 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 藻园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館由西南門迤西為藻園内為曠然堂五楹堂後為貯清書屋曠然堂東池上為夕佳書屋稍北為鏡瀾榭東南樓為凝眺為懷新館西北為湛碧軒西南為湛清華（圓明園冊）臣等謹按藻園曠然堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: Out by the south-west gate of 長春仙館: 藻園 with the five-bay 曠然堂, 貯清書屋, 夕佳書屋, 鏡瀾榭, the tower 凝眺, 懷新館, 湛碧軒 and 湛清華.

evidence.title: 湛碧轩
evidence.locator: v3 p.218, under 藻园; source ref 7-276
evidence.excerpt_zh: 冻解濩索流澌，湛然凝碧一池。朅览楣间题额，真是应节及时。
evidence.summary: Poem 湛碧轩 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 藻园.

evidence.title: 湛碧轩: 乾隆二十六年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十六年 (1761), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 初生水色绿于筠，静敛东风不作沦。自是春光还改故，那能人意免欢新。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 湛碧轩, 1761, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 湛碧轩: 乾隆五十五年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆五十五年 (1790), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 水裔构文轩，其名曰湛碧。碧待湛为澄，澄则碧呈色。能所本相资，胥有为法格。云何臻无为，轩弗言脉脉。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 湛碧轩, 1790, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 湛碧轩: 乾隆六十年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆六十年 (1795), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 湖裔有轩久，湛碧宿所名。其义固因水，乃兹来见冰。俯景别生会，虚实象殊呈。结为冰静寂，化原水动顷。而其湛与碧，本一非二形。更绎两字间，动输觉静赢。以其无波澜，澄心者自明。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 湛碧轩, 1795, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 湛碧轩
evidence.summary: 湛碧轩: 3 dated items, 1761-1795, of which 3 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1761, last dated 1795.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
